# QR encoder (vendored)

`qrcodegen.py` is the unmodified Project Nayuki QR Code generator library, PyPI version **1.8.0**. MIT license and copyright are retained in the source header.

- Project: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
- Package: https://pypi.org/project/qrcodegen/1.8.0/
- Source SHA-256: `b089855caf16185c61421ea4927c1b213cf9468940d71fa8ab11ef83662dcc84`

Pure Python, standard library only. No network calls or extra runtime installation. Python source files are not served by the HTTP handler.
